row.notes: Builds a session's extra worlds from track layer rows. layers (8-byte row pointers, u64 count at +0x100) wins when it is non-null and non-empty; otherwise entity vt+0xc8 (Trk_ChampionshipEntity_TrackDataQuery_Body 0x1485962f0 in the base, benchmark, championship and Time Trial vtables) fills a 6-byte query and Trk_TrackData_CollectLayersForQuery 0x142e60550 takes every matching row of [entity+0xf58]+0x1e0. Each row goes through Game_TrackLayer_BuildExtraWorldDesc 0x142e57e90 (0x150-byte stack records) and is copied into worlds. Callers: championship BuildSessionSettings 0x1407b7e33 (layers from 0x1407b7950: the team icon entity's +0x2c0 list, the career setup track_layer_override list, the dev session list), benchmark 0x1407a6554 and Time Trial 0x1487321c2 (layers null), 0x142df739e, and the custom team config slot 10 body 0x14d45e55a (the config row's track_layers_override at row+0x40, count +0x140).
